examples.setup: Just a reminder to check on your elderly relatives during these hot summer months.
examples.punchline: Hi Dad. There, my job’s done.

examples.setup: A Baltimore Raven published a complex study in a math journal.
examples.punchline: The NFL suspended him for unsportsmanlike conduct.

examples.setup: I lost $500 betting yesterday.
examples.punchline: Not on the Super Bowl, on “Downton Abbey.”

examples.setup: It's being reported that Google and Yahoo are in serious talks to buy Hulu.
examples.punchline: I don't have a joke here, I just wanted to confuse my mother.

examples.setup: Last night I was visited by a ghost who claimed he had "unfinished business."
examples.punchline: Turns out he just needed something notarized.

examples.setup: ABC announced that the "The Bachelor" and "The Bachelorette" will now feature a more diverse cast.
examples.punchline: They’re going to add a contestant who has read a book.

examples.setup: A college student in Georgia was worried that his parents would be mad at him for flunking English, so he faked his own kidnapping.
examples.punchline: However, the parents figured it out when the ransom note said, "We Has Your Son."

examples.setup: A new report says that 80% of sunscreens either don't work or have questionable ingredients.
examples.punchline: In a related story, I don’t have long to live.

examples.setup: Yesterday, a woman gave birth after running the Chicago Marathon.
examples.punchline: Immediately after the race, the baby was disqualified for cheating.

examples.setup: While working on the LA subway, construction workers have discovered fossils from the ice age.
examples.punchline: The fossils belong to the last creature to ever use the Los Angeles subway.

examples.setup: An Ohio school is requiring students who want to be on the yearbook committee be tested for drugs.
examples.punchline: The yearbook committee is protesting, saying, "If we were cool enough to do drugs, we wouldn't be on the yearbook committee."

examples.setup: This weekend was the first YouTube Music Awards show and Eminem won Artist of the Year.
examples.punchline: Second runner up was a cat walking across a piano.

examples.setup: Sunday was daylight savings time, when we lose an hour for no apparent reason.
examples.punchline: And, by the way, "losing an hour for no apparent reason" is also the motto for this show.

examples.setup: Bono has apologized for putting the U2 album in peoples' iTunes without their permission.
examples.punchline: For the full version of his apology, check your voicemail, it’s there.

examples.setup: This holiday weekend, Chicago's Midway airport is featuring live blues and jazz performances for passengers waiting at baggage claim.
examples.punchline: Not to be outdone, New York's JFK airport will feature baggage belonging to the passengers in Chicago.

examples.setup: There’s a cold snap, and even in Hollywood, temperatures are in the 50s.
examples.punchline: Of course, since it’s Hollywood, the weather is telling everyone it’s only in its mid-30s.

examples.setup: It’s rumored that the new PlayStation controller will measure the degree to which you’re sweating.
examples.punchline: In response, gamers asked, “What’s sweating?”

examples.setup: A company has come out with a robot that makes salad.
examples.punchline: So finally - a robot that’s not going to take away any American jobs!

examples.setup: Long John Silvers has just hired a new executive to completely revamp their menu.
examples.punchline: For starters, he said they're going to start experimenting with something called "fish."

examples.setup: I like my coffee the way I like my jokes about the way I like my coffee.
examples.punchline: I don’t drink coffee.

examples.setup: In Florida, an Anheuser-Busch truck collided with a Frito-Lay truck, spilling beer and chips all over the highway.
examples.punchline: Of course in Florida they call that an "Easter miracle."

examples.setup: Starbucks just announced it will be raising its coffee prices.
examples.punchline: When asked why, Starbucks said, "Because it’s been a week since we had any bad publicity. We had to do something."

examples.setup: An 18-year-old has started a GoFundMe page so he can achieve his dream of taking a bath in KFC gravy.
examples.punchline: So far, most of his donations have been provided by the Make a Sad Wish Foundation.

examples.setup: "Game of Thrones" creator George R.R. Martin has put an end to the rumor that there will be a "Game of Thrones" movie.
examples.punchline: Martin said, "There’s no way I could keep a character alive for two hours straight."

examples.setup: A new study finds that men with thick biceps are more likely to live longer.
examples.punchline: The study also found that I died 10 years ago.

examples.setup: Over the weekend here in California, a riot broke out at a national surfing competition.
examples.punchline: Nobody was killed, but one man is listed in stable but “gnarly” condition.

examples.setup: In six states, bagged salads sold at Wal-Mart have been recalled.
examples.punchline: The salad recall affects approximately 100 Wal-Mart stores and zero Wal-Mart customers.

examples.setup: To celebrate Leap Day, Arby’s is offering a special vegetarian menu.
examples.punchline: Arby’s said, "It’s part of our commitment to offer healthy food, once every four years."

examples.setup: Over the last few months, Home Depot is reporting record profits.
examples.punchline: Home Depot said they'd like to share the profits with their employees but even they can't find them.

examples.setup: Dr. Dre may become the world’s first hip-hop billionaire.
examples.punchline: So maybe my mom was right--I should’ve become a doctor.

examples.setup: A company has created a bathroom scale that allows you to tweet your weight to your friends.
examples.punchline: The company immediately went out of business.

examples.setup: Uber has announced a new service where you carpool with strangers.
examples.punchline: It’s a cutting edge new technology called, "taking the bus."

examples.setup: Both the US and German teams have very good goalies, so many are predicting a very low scoring game.
examples.punchline: So don’t expect to see one of those 1-0 blowouts.

examples.setup: "Wind Beneath My Wings" is a great song, but what about the wind ABOVE her wings?
examples.punchline: It’s technically just as important for lift.

examples.setup: In LA this morning, a woman gave birth to a healthy baby on the shoulder of the 605 Freeway.
examples.punchline: It's amazing what people will do out here just to use the carpool lane.

examples.setup: Taco Bell is following up its Doritos tacos with new taco shells made of Fritos.
examples.punchline: It’s all part of Taco Bell’s new slogan, "Working Our Way Down the Stuff You Find Next To a 7-Eleven Cash Register."

examples.setup: In Germany, researchers were recently able to stop light from traveling for an extended period of time.
examples.punchline: Here’s how they did it-- they placed the light on United Airlines.

examples.setup: For its 25th anniversary, the music festival Lollapalooza is adding a fourth day.
examples.punchline: That extra day will be devoted to showering.

examples.setup: The pastor who incorrectly predicted the Rapture this Saturday was quoted as saying, "It's been a really tough weekend."
examples.punchline: To make things worse, his friends keep calling to say, "Hey, come on, it's not the end of the world."

examples.setup: This Valentine's Day, there's a new app called the "Love Calculator" that enables users to calculate their chances at love.
examples.punchline: Of course sometimes the app goes by its original name, a "breathalyzer."

examples.setup: This weekend "Spider-Man 2" earned $92 million at the box office.
examples.punchline: That makes it the fourth most successful "Spider-Man 2."

examples.setup: Apple recently said that every idea for an Apple product begins with "delight, surprise, love, and connection."
examples.punchline: Apple said, "Then we add a $600 price tag on it and BOOM."

examples.setup: A Southwest Airlines flight landed at the wrong airport in Missouri.
examples.punchline: A spokesperson for Southwest said, "Close enough."

examples.setup: Amazon Prime has made it possible to have beer and wine delivered to your home by Alexa.
examples.punchline: All you have to do is say the phrase, "Alexa, Daddy’s sad."

examples.setup: The very first Academy Awards ceremony lasted 15 minutes.
examples.punchline: And thanks to the fast forward button on my DVR, so will this year’s.

examples.setup: A new study says we should change how we feed cows so they don’t produce so much of the greenhouse gas: methane.
examples.punchline: The first step they recommend -- eliminate "Taco Night."

examples.setup: During the Super Bowl, Quicken Loans debuted a new app that lets people get a mortgage instantly on their phones by just tapping the screen.
examples.punchline: The app is called, "What could possibly go wrong?"

examples.setup: A Texas man has successfully fired the first-ever gun created by a 3-D printer.
examples.punchline: Which raises the question – Don't you think a gun created by a printer would jam?

examples.setup: Law & Order has released a 104 disc box set of every episode of the show.
examples.punchline: Now fans of the Law & Order franchise have 2 options: either buy this exclusive 104 disc DVD collection or just turn on your television to any channel and wait 5 minutes.

examples.setup: Facebook has announced a way for users to "unsend" messages.
examples.punchline: All you do is go to the message center and click the button marked "I Was Drunk."

examples.setup: New research shows that giraffes hum, but only at night.
examples.punchline: Even more surprising: They all hum that Chili’s "Babyback Ribs" song.

examples.setup: Pluto is larger than previously thought, and on its surface there is a shape that looks like a heart.
examples.punchline: So now, scientists are deciding whether to classify Pluto as a planet or an emoji.

examples.setup: Baskin Robbins introduced a new ice cream flavor called "Ice Cream Nachos."
examples.punchline: They came up with the idea yesterday at 4:20.

examples.setup: Just read a study claiming dogs can feel love, which is yet another way dogs are superior to cats.
examples.punchline: And comedians.

examples.setup: 7-Eleven announced it’s now offering "breakfast pizza."
examples.punchline: It’s all in keeping with 7-Eleven’s motto: "If You’re Here, You’re Probably Hungover."

examples.setup: An American judo fighter was expelled from the Olympics after testing positive for marijuana.
examples.punchline: Officials became suspicious when he kept stopping the match and saying, "What are we fighting for, man?"

examples.setup: A New York City pedicab driver is being investigated for charging Japenese tourists $720 for a 20 minute bike ride.
examples.punchline: He’s been charged with impersonating a regular cab driver.

examples.setup: I'm going to miss the World Cup when it's over.
examples.punchline: It'll be hard to go into a bar & not hear people yelling about something I don't understand.

examples.setup: Hey can someone send me an Oculus Rift VR headset?
examples.punchline: I finally want to try parasailing.

examples.setup: The Grateful Dead are putting out an 80-disc live box set.
examples.punchline: No word yet on which Grateful Dead song it will be.

examples.setup: I can't wait to try the new gigantic Starbucks size, "Trenta".
examples.punchline: Or as it's called in The Midwest, "A Medium".

examples.setup: A Spanish tennis player has been suspended after testing positive for meth.
examples.punchline: Tennis officials grew suspicious when he started returning his own serves.

examples.setup: The government has unveiled a new website that predicts your financial worth after graduating college.
examples.punchline: It doesn’t give a number, it just tells you which Starbucks you’ll be working at and for how long.

examples.setup: A man from Houston is attempting to visit all the Starbucks locations in the world.
examples.punchline: It's been four years since he started and he still hasn't left Houston.

examples.setup: According to new research, you may be at risk of bacterial infections from clothing you buy at the mall.
examples.punchline: Experts say the store you most want to avoid is "Victoria's Really Disgusting Secret."

examples.setup: The oldest person on Facebook is a 101-year-old woman.
examples.punchline: She said, "I want to waste what little time I have left."

examples.setup: A new study indicates 93% of women feel their armpits are unattractive.
examples.punchline: The study was conducted by the Association of Researchers Who Have Run Out of Questions to Ask Women.

examples.setup: The International Olympic Committee has officially recognized Ultimate Frisbee as an Olympic sport.
examples.punchline: The news was greeted with excitement by thousands of guys named "Chad."

examples.setup: The Garmin company is now offering a new GPS device that has the voice of Yoda.
examples.punchline: Maybe it's just me, but if I'm getting turn-by-turn directions, do I really want someone who speaks backwards?

examples.setup: The government shutdown will slash the budget for food inspection.
examples.punchline: That’s bad news for health advocates, but great news for the new Japanese restaurant, "Leap-Of-Faith Sushi."

examples.setup: A new survey has found that for the third year in a row, the most annoying word in the English language is "Whatever."
examples.punchline: The news was taken especially hard by the top-secret government lab that developed "Brosephus."

examples.setup: Earlier this week, investor Warren Buffett lost $2 billion.
examples.punchline: Luckily, Buffett found it this morning under a pile of $8 billion.

examples.setup: McDonald's has announced its Happy Meals will include an apple slice and half the amount of French Fries.
examples.punchline: In a related story, the Happy Meal will now just be called, "The Meal."

examples.setup: Campbells is recalling over 300,000 cans of Spaghettios.
examples.punchline: Turns out, they contain a very dangerous substance called “Spaghettios.”

examples.setup: It’s raining so hard now, we’re actually having mudslides here in LA.
examples.punchline: This morning I was driving to work and I was passed by a house.

examples.setup: A couple in Arkansas who love the Olive Garden have named their infant daughter "Olivia Garton."
examples.punchline: Olivia went home today, where she joined her big brother, Hooters.

examples.setup: A new study found that government employees are the happiest workers.
examples.punchline: The study was conducted NOT at the DMV.

examples.setup: Dartmouth College has named their medical school after Dr. Seuss.
examples.punchline: Because nothing is better than hearing your doctor say, "You don't have cancer on your nose, you don't have cancer on your toes."

examples.setup: Lufthansa Airlines will soon allow pet falcons aboard their flights.
examples.punchline: This is bad news for Lufthansa passengers with seeing eye mice.

examples.setup: Another day of heavy rain here in Los Angeles.
examples.punchline: Which is great if you’re worried about the drought, or if you just like the smell of wet man bun.
